sections.text:
In a distant kingdom covered in white snow, a very beautiful baby girl was born to the king and queen, and they named her “Snow White.”

Snow White had skin as pure as snow, lips as red as the blood of a rose, and hair as dark as ebony.

Unfortunately, her kind mother died when she was young, and the king married another very beautiful but cruel and arrogant woman.

The new queen had a magic mirror hanging in her room, and she would ask it every day: “Oh mirror hanging on the wall, who is the most beautiful woman in this land?”

The magic mirror, which only spoke the truth, always answered her: “You, my lady, are the most beautiful of all women.”

This answer satisfied the queen's vanity and made her happy, but as the years passed, Snow White grew older and more beautiful and delicate day by day.

One day, when the Queen asked her mirror the usual question, the answer was shocking: “You are beautiful, my lady, but Snow White is now the most beautiful!”

The fires of jealousy and envy burned in the heart of the evil queen, and she could not bear the idea of ​​having someone more beautiful than her in the kingdom.

The Queen summoned the kingdom's loyal hunter, and secretly ordered him to take Snow White deep into the forest and kill her, and to bring her heart in a box as evidence of her death.

The hunter took Snow White into the forest, and when they were about to kill her, the princess cried and begged him to have mercy on her.

The hunter, who knew the kindness of her heart, could not commit this heinous crime, so he said to her: “Run, my princess, into the depths of the forest and never return, for the queen wants to kill you.”

Then he hunted a wild boar and took its heart in the box to deceive the evil queen, who was happy thinking that she had gotten rid of her rival.

As for Snow White, she ran into the dark and scary forest, where the trees looked like monsters roaming in the darkness.

She kept running until she fell from fatigue, and the next morning, she saw cute birds and animals that led her to a very small hut in the middle of the forest.

I entered the hut and found it empty, but everything in it was small and skillfully made: seven little chairs, seven little dishes, and seven little beds.

Snow White cleaned and arranged the hut and cooked delicious food, then she fell asleep and slept on the small bed.

In the evening, the owners of the hut returned from their work in the diamond mine, and they were seven good-natured dwarves.

When they saw Snow White sleeping, they were surprised by her beauty, and when she woke up, she told them her sad story.

The Seven Dwarves welcomed Snow White, and agreed that she should live with them, protect them, and bring them food, in exchange for providing her with shelter and safety.

Snow White lived happily with the dwarves, who loved her as a sister, and always warned her not to open the door to any stranger during their absence.

Meanwhile, in the palace, the Queen asked her mirror again, and the mirror replied: “Snow White is still alive and lives with the dwarves in the forest, and she is much more beautiful than you!”

The Queen became extremely angry and decided to kill Snow White herself this time.

The queen went to the palace's secret cellar and made a poisoned apple, the red half of which was fatal and the green half of which was healthy.

Then she disguised herself as a poor old woman selling apples, and went to the dwarves' hut after they went out to work.

She knocked on the door and offered the apples to Snow White, who hesitated at first, remembering the dwarves' warning.

But the cunning old woman cut the apple, ate the green half to convince her that it was safe, and gave the red half to Snow White.

As soon as Snow White took one bite of the red half, she fell to the ground, unconscious as if dead.

The Evil Queen returned to the palace laughing, and the mirror assured her that she had finally become the most beautiful.

The dwarves returned and found Snow White motionless. They were deeply saddened and cried for long days.

They were not willing to bury her underground because of her unchanged beauty, so they made a coffin of transparent glass for her and placed her in it in the middle of the forest, and they guarded her alternately.

One day, a handsome prince from a neighboring kingdom passed by the coffin. He was enchanted by Snow White's beauty and fell in love with her at first sight.

The prince asked the dwarves to take the coffin with him to take care of it, and they agreed after they saw the sincerity of his feelings.

While carrying the coffin, one of the prince's guards stumbled, and the coffin shook violently, causing a piece of poisoned apple to come out of Snow White's throat!
The princess woke up, opened her eyes, and saw the handsome prince looking at her with love and concern.

Everyone was happy, and the prince asked for her hand in marriage. She agreed, and a great wedding was held, attended by the seven dwarves.

As for the Evil Queen, she died of rage and envy, and Snow White lived with her prince and her dwarf friends in eternal happiness and peace.
